notes.title: News on Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

I've got some good news, and some bad news.

Good news:

1. The map is almost done, it just needs some functioning and clutter it up with items.

2. I was able to optimize and cut some corners on AI. Now, even on my PC setup (it's a bit weak, not gonna lie), I had up to 45-50 fps with 80 AI on screen.

Now bad news...

Due to AI optimization, some of the systems became unusable. I have a solution, but I need time to implement it.

notes.title: Small Update on Development
notes.notes:
Hello!

I have some small news on next update that I like to share with you.

New feature:

Stuns.

Viir will be stunned when hit by a dwarf. Type of stun will be determined by the weapon they got hit by.

Axes: Light stun.

Swords: Medium stun.

Hammers: Heavy stun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43202775/6e9883c95c7c493c150a33f20dbc0d6b4d6d3641.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Update on Development
notes.notes:
Hello!

I have some small news on next update that I like to share with you.

So, I'm planning to add a new ability to the game.

Kick!

The dwarf will be able to kick surrounding physics objects and hitting Viir with them.

I found it very fun to do. And I hope you will have fun with it too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43202775/e3e4ca6246f80b0a0ed2fcacb544ddfcdd6f9fab.png[/img]

notes.title: News on Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Some news on what to expect in the next update:


First.

Level "Mine Number Three Scout Mission" will be unavailable, until it will be re-worked.
Instead, Level "Old Settelment" take its place.

Second.

Normal Viir was hard to hit target, so in next update Normal Viir animations will be re-worked to make them stand on their own two legs instead of being crouched


Third and last.

On next update I'm planning to release a free demo version of the game. It will have All Melee Weapons (Iron Rarity only), All Armor (Iron Rarity only), 1 Level (Normal Difficulty only), Crafting (Iron Rarity only).


Date of the next update isn't clear yet, there is a lot of work to be done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43202775/c64d2bdcd870e3b2654ff9a21e77cd90a96cc1bd.png[/img]

notes.title: News on Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Some news on next update:

I'm moving some updates earlier in the development, also reworking existing things.

So, What does that mean?

First.

The roadmap will be frozen until I re-work it.

Second.

The next update will come out some time later than usual.

Next update will move the game from Pre-Alpha stage into the Alpha.

It will contain updates that were supposed to come out later, some stuff will be reworked, and all updates that were supposed to come out on Pre-Alpha stage.

And some sneak peek ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43202775/828c32efb5ddebaf61570d1b80054cce07ef7dd4.png[/img]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Major Update #2 is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello!

In this update some new features have been added to the game!

List of Updates:

Smithing Update:
[list]
[*] Weapons and armor craft is now available for players.
[/list]

New weapons: Swords

Swords are now available to craft.

Types of swords available to craft:
[list]
[*] Sword
[*] Two handed sword
[*] Sword and shield
[/list]

Weapon and Armor Quality Update:

Attributes of weapons and armor will change based on Quality, which is determined by the player's craftsmanship in smithing.


Also in this update:

Dwarf animations and timings have been changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43202775/fd84883bd45e1e4ea7b9812c6cee5ca70a7ef431.png[/img]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Major Update #1 is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello!

In this update some new features have been added to the game!

List of Updates:

Added new enemy: Viir Mage.

[list]
[*] Viir mage is a fireball casting ranged enemy.
[/list]


Armor Update:

Armor is now a part of gameplay.

Armor Types:
[list]
[*] Light Armor
[*] Medium Armor (Coming soon)
[*] Heavy Armor (Coming soon)
[/list]

Armor attributes:
[list]
[*] Damage Absorption. Absorbs any enemy damage in percents.
[*] Speed Decrease. Decreases player speed in percents.
[/list]

Attributes changes based on the type and rarity of the Armor.


Ore mining update:

Ore gathering is now available for players on missions.

Ore types:
[list]
[*] Iron
[*] Steel
[*] Silver
[*] Gold
[*] Core
[/list]

Ore type changes based on mission difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43202775/4516f0c87840f7fcc55385f966f46b5ab0de08e8.png[/img]
